processing_path: Document processing runs in the browser on the user's device; optional cloud AI and checkout are separate networked features.
published_deletion_or_retention: No normal document-processing server upload for core local workflows, so no server-side file-retention window for those workflows.
local_or_offline_option: Yes; local browser processing is the default for core tools and many workflows can continue after the app and required resources have loaded.

processing_path: Files are uploaded to Smallpdf infrastructure for processing and protected in transit with TLS.
published_deletion_or_retention: Smallpdf states free-tool files are deleted after 1 hour; account-stored files follow account storage controls.
local_or_offline_option: This dataset row describes Smallpdf's online tools.

processing_path: Content files are processed on iLovePDF servers.
published_deletion_or_retention: iLovePDF states that, except for iLoveSign, content files are deleted within 2 hours after processing.
local_or_offline_option: This dataset row describes the web service.

processing_path: Files are uploaded for the online workflow.
published_deletion_or_retention: Sejda states online files are automatically deleted after 2 hours.
local_or_offline_option: Sejda Desktop is offered as an offline alternative where files do not leave the computer.

processing_path: Online tools process uploaded files on PDF24 processing servers.
published_deletion_or_retention: PDF24 states files are automatically deleted from the processing server within 1 hour after processing.
local_or_offline_option: PDF24 Creator is a Windows desktop alternative that works locally and offline.

processing_path: Adobe states Acrobat online services upload files to Adobe cloud storage.
published_deletion_or_retention: Adobe states unsigned-in files are deleted from the server within a short time period; signed-in users can save files to their Adobe account.
local_or_offline_option: This dataset row covers Acrobat online services, not the separate desktop Acrobat application.

processing_path: PDFgear states these tools process PDFs directly in the browser without uploading them.
published_deletion_or_retention: PDFgear states files remain on the user's device and are not stored by the service for this client-side tool set.
local_or_offline_option: Yes; PDFgear states these client-side tools can function without internet after opening.
